shots.detail_en: CH watches the sixth green candle of Lianhua Industrial slam down onto the great board as its cold light cuts across the hall floor.
shots.speaker: 散户甲

shots.detail_en: CH stands within a churning sea of heads as the pressure of the board bears down and green light stamps every upturned face.
shots.sub: 顶不住了！砸盘的连人影都看不见！
shots.speaker: 散户乙

shots.detail_en: CH's eyes hold still as the seventh green candle drops, the board now so green it turns black.
MANCANG is cornered by his own panicked floral-shirt recruits pressing him for an answer in the middle of the hall.
shots.sub: 军团长！撤不撤啊？！／谁、谁说的！我满仓兄弟——从来没撤过！
shots.speaker: 散户甲+满仓

shots.detail_en: MANCANG grips his shivering pager in a palm slick with sweat, his confidence cracking for the first time.
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: RED flips through her ledger at record speed, pen tip racing line after line of figures behind the counter.
shots.sub: 第七根阴线了——他一笔都没动。单子像焊死在盘口上。
shots.speaker: 红利

shots.detail_en: CH stands unmoving at the very foot of the great board, tie hanging plumb-straight, letting the eighth green candle pour over his head.
shots.sub: 第八根阴线落下来的时候，整个大厅——只剩我还站着。
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: CH alone remains upright as the ninth candle falls and nine green bars stack into a full wall across the great board, a spectacle of doom pressing down on the hall.
shots.speaker: 散户群

shots.detail_en: CH turns and walks alone against the fleeing tide of bodies toward the back stairway.
FATHER and BOY sit shoulder to shoulder on the 1993 rooftop in warm aged light, the old exchange building small in the distance behind them.
shots.sub: 长虹，数阴线。／一、二……好多根，看得心里发慌。
shots.speaker: 父亲+少年长虹

shots.detail_en: FATHER takes BOY's hand and presses it flat against the boy's own chest, holding it there over his heartbeat.
shots.sub: 连看九根阴线，看到的不是盘——是人自己的心跳。心跳不乱，阴线就只是阴线。
shots.speaker: 父亲

shots.detail_en: FATHER laughs warmly as BOY nods hard, the old green glow of the board mirrored in the boy's eyes.
shots.sub: 慌了，就先回家吃饭。／那盘呢？／盘明天还在。心跳没了，就没了。
shots.speaker: 父亲+少年长虹

shots.detail_en: CH clutches the slow-by-one-minute pocket watch to his chest on the rainy-night rooftop, eyes shut, counting his own heartbeat.
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: CH opens his eyes as rainwater slides down his hair onto the mended break of the watch chain, a small fire burning in his gaze.
CH looks down from the rooftop as the exchange's neon smears through the rain and a faint green glow leaks from the hall below.
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: MANCANG hugs the hall pillar for dear life in the same posture as the day they first met, as the panic peaks and the crowd shoves toward the exits.
shots.sub: 别挤！都别挤……军团……军团散了……
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: MANCANG's face is slick with sweat, real fear surfacing on it for the first time.
shots.sub: 完了……连陆先生……都不说话了……
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: CH walks back into the hall against the outbound tide and stops alone at the center of the emptied floor, one man crossing an empty arena.
RED slides a folded note across the counter and CH picks it up, unfolding her red-inked line.
shots.sub: 今天所有人都在等一个奇迹。／我赌你今晚，还会站在这儿。
shots.speaker: 红利

shots.detail_en: CH grips the note and the pocket watch together before the darkened board, his lone back very small inside the vast empty hall.
shots.sub: 他们等奇迹。我等——一根阳线。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: Black end-card with white title text teasing the next episode.
shots.card: 第九根阴线之后，是第十天。下集《你赢的是行情》
